# Diagnostic codes

<!-- type: reference · level: 1 -->

Every refusal nano-ros prints carries a code, `NROS-` and four digits:

```text
error[NROS-0004]: src/demo_bringup/system.toml: names no board
  help: add `board = "<board>"` to the `[image.<id>]` table in system.toml
  explain: nros explain NROS-0004
```

The `explain:` line is a command: `nros explain NROS-0004` prints the
page below without a network or a checkout. A code never changes its
meaning, and a retired code names the one that replaced it.

| code | what went wrong |
| --- | --- |
| [NROS-0001](NROS-0001.md) | ROS 2 is not sourced, and the project has messages to generate |
| [NROS-0002](NROS-0002.md) | an image names a board that no board descriptor claims |
| [NROS-0003](NROS-0003.md) | the workspace declares no image |
| [NROS-0004](NROS-0004.md) | an image names no board |
| [NROS-0005](NROS-0005.md) | a board's platform reaches no built-in family |
| [NROS-0006](NROS-0006.md) | no diagnostic has this code |
